_note: The four libraries this app is built on. Each entry pins an exact version, records the SHA-256 of the exact bytes this app was tested against, and gives the CDN URL those bytes came from. Run `python3 get-vendor.py` to pull them into vendor/ and the app will prefer the local copy over the CDN — that is what makes a genuinely air-gapped deployment possible.

pdf.what: pdf.js — reads PDFs, with per-item font sizes so headings can be inferred

pdfWorker.what: pdf.js worker — the actual page rasteriser and text extractor

mammoth.what: mammoth — converts .docx to HTML, which preserves real heading levels

transformers.what: transformers.js — runs the ONNX embedding model on WebGPU or WebAssembly

webllm.what: WebLLM — the optional on-device language model that writes the answer
